name: Sentry
description: Persona, skill, and HTTP API tools to monitor Sentry error tracking via its REST API and a personal User Auth Token — list projects, query recent/filtered issues, inspect an issue's latest event and stacktrace, resolve/ignore/assign issues, and list releases. Authenticated by SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN against the organization SENTRY_ORG_SLUG (sentry.io SaaS).
